supersession_rule: GST_PROSPECTIVE_HYPOTHESIS_REGISTRY_v1.3.json is NOT edited in place. It remains on disk, unchanged, byte-for-byte, CONTRADICTION INCLUDED -- a superseded version is allowed to be wrong, which is what superseded means. This version is a consistency correction: it resolves a self-contradiction v1.3 introduced. It resolves no decision, changes no threshold, moves no hypothesis, and alters no measurement.
change_summary: Resolves a SELF-CONTRADICTION in v1.3. v1.3 corrected HYP-04's linkage availability to 'exists_partial' but left two other statements in the same document asserting that no linkage map exists (eligible_event_counts.note and statistical_governance.adding_a_hypothesis_rule). Nothing computed from either sentence and no display-gate condition read them, so no result or decision was affected -- but a governance document that asserts two incompatible things is what these documents exist to prevent. NO hypothesis is modified, reclassified, promoted, demoted or re-thresholded; no measurement, capture path or decision ledger changes. HYP-04's status remains PREREGISTERED_MEASUREMENT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED and the gate stays CLOSED with C4 MET.
authored_at_utc_note: Dated the day HYP-04 was authorised by the repo owner.
authored_before_any_candidate_screening_: FALSE for this version, and stated plainly rather than inherited from v1.0. Round-1 cohort screening has occurred and one event (EVT-DELL-FY27Q2-ERN) is registered since v1.0 was authored, so the unqualified v1.0 claim would be false here. The scoped claim that IS true: this version was authored before any HYP-04 observation exists, before any peer linkage map exists, and before any HYP-04 result has been produced or looked at. HYP-04 accrues zero eligible events.

critical_distinction.statement: gst_market_response.completeness.HYPOTHESIS_CLASSES are DATA-ELIGIBILITY CLASSES, not named research hypotheses. A class says which evidence modules an event carries. A hypothesis is a named, dated research question with its own threshold, classification and display gate. They are registered separately here and mapped explicitly.

statuses.ACTIVE_COLLECTING: Every required measurement already has a production field AND a production capture path. Collection may proceed; results stay gated by the threshold.
statuses.PREREGISTERED_MEASUREMENT_NOT_IMPLEMENTE: The question is registered and dated, but at least one required measurement has no production field, no production capture path, or no production join. The hypothesis accrues NO eligible events until that is built under a separate authorised task. Missing implementation is never counted as eligibility.

statuses_note: The status vocabulary is UNCHANGED from v1.0. No new status value was introduced for HYP-04. A candidate value considered and rejected during authoring -- PREREGISTERED_MEASUREMENT_IMPLEMENTED_PENDING_LINKAGE -- is not part of this enum and was not added, because inventing a status to describe a partially-built hypothesis would weaken the one distinction this enum exists to enforce: whether a production capture path exists at all. HYP-04's analysis code existing does not make its measurement reachable, and the enum should keep saying so.

hypotheses.title: Supply-chain peer volatility transmission and lag
hypotheses.question: Supply-chain/competitor peer volatility transmission and lag following anchor earnings shocks

minimum_eligible_events_basis.governance_character: This is a GOVERNANCE ELIGIBILITY FLOOR, in the same sense as HYP-01/02/03's 60/60/40 -- the minimum evidence required before any result may be looked at. It is NOT a claim of guaranteed statistical power and NOT an estimate of detectable effect size. See statistical_governance.power_statement, which this entry does not override.
minimum_eligible_events_basis.unit_discipline: Stated in ANCHOR EVENTS, the same unit as every other threshold in this registry. It is deliberately NOT stated in (anchor x peer) pairs. The pair-level reading of the same derivation is a much weaker bar -- with ~5-10 peers per anchor it could be satisfied by a small fraction of the event count -- and leaving the unit ambiguous is the specific defect Patch 2 of HYP04_PLAN_ROUND2_EDITS.md was written to eliminate.
minimum_eligible_events_basis.derivation_summary: Phase 0 feasibility work derived an effective-sample-size target of N_eff ~193, where N_eff = N_pairs / DEFF and DEFF = 1 + (m_bar - 1) * ICC. The 193 recorded here is the conservative ICC = 1 endpoint, at which N_eff collapses to the anchor-event count -- so the event-unit floor and the effective-observation target coincide. At any empirically observed ICC below 1, N_eff is reached with fewer anchor events than 193, never more; the floor is therefore conservative in the direction that demands MORE evidence, not less.

derivation_inputs.assumed_effect_size_character: hypothetical, externally chosen, NOT derived from any observed project result
derivation_inputs.multiplicity_correction: Sidak over the effective number of independent horizon tests, measured empirically at k = 6.05-6.34 across a 20-horizon grid by a max-T permutation run against synthetic fixtures
derivation_inputs.naive_single_test_baseline_note: LABELLED BASELINE ONLY. Never the operative floor.

minimum_eligible_events_basis.why_this_does_not_violate_the_power_stat: The power_statement forbids a power calculation performed USING OBSERVED PROJECT RESULTS. This derivation used a hypothetical effect size (d = 0.5, chosen before any data) and synthetic fixtures with known injected ground truth. No observed project result, and no real peer or anchor data, entered it. The resulting number is recorded as a governance floor, not as a power guarantee, consistent with how this registry characterises all of its thresholds.
minimum_eligible_events_basis.derivation_reference: Live Signal Engine/HYP04_PLAN_ROUND2_EDITS.md (Patch 2) and Live Signal Engine/HYP04_PHASE0_FEASIBILITY_STATUS_2026-08-18.md (section 5)
minimum_eligible_events_basis.revisable: This floor may be revised only by a further dated registry version written BEFORE the results that would motivate the revision are seen -- the same discipline the promotion_rule imposes.

hypotheses.required_eligibility_class_note: This is the ANCHOR-side requirement only: an anchor event must itself be core-eligible for its earnings shock to be usable. The PEER-side measurement has no eligibility class in gst_market_response.completeness.HYPOTHESIS_CLASSES at all, which is one of the reasons this hypothesis is NOT_IMPLEMENTED. No existing class is stretched to cover it, and no new class is created by this registry version.
hypotheses.status_basis: Two of the three capture paths named in v1.2 now have production modules; the LINKAGE MAP is partially curated. NONE of this means data has flowed. (1) The supply-chain/competitor LINKAGE MAP now exists in part -- 2 curated edge(s) as of 2026-08-22 -- against a requirement measured in eligible anchor events, so it remains the binding blocker on Phase 1. Phase 0 ran, and still runs, entirely on the positional-synthetic placeholder. (2) A capture path for PEER-side return series EXISTS (hyp04_supply_chain_hedge/peer_returns.py): it validates operator-supplied closes into per-peer daily log returns on a shared session index and DERIVES peer-history availability rather than accepting it. ZERO peer price data has been captured through it. A path that can ingest is not ingested data. (3) The join mapping a market-response event_id to peer observations EXISTS (hyp04_supply_chain_hedge/linkage_resolution.py) and derives uses_placeholder_linkage from what was actually read. No production run has used it. Working analysis code operating on synthetic fixtures is not a production capture path, and this registry does not treat it as one -- that rule is unchanged from v1.2 and is why HYP-04's status does not move.

required_external_measurement.measurement: supply-chain / competitor / customer linkage map, per anchor ticker
required_external_measurement.as_of_date_requirement: The first-known/established-as-of date per pair is REQUIRED, not optional. A linkage map built today encodes relationships known today; applying it to historical anchor events without knowing when each relationship was first publicly established is look-ahead bias -- the same class of defect this project's own forensic audit already found in the reconstructed GST z-score history. A map delivered without this column is a blocking data-quality failure, not a partial delivery.
required_external_measurement.placeholder_used_in_phase_0: POSITIONAL-SYNTHETIC pairing -- peers[i*k:(i+1)*k] in fixtures.py. Peers are the non-anchor tickers from AllTickers_Sectors.csv assigned to anchors by list position; the sector column is NOT read for pairing.
required_external_measurement.placeholder_is_never_evidence: No result computed on the placeholder linkage is evidence about supply-chain transmission, and none may be reported as such.
required_external_measurement.availability_basis: As of 2026-08-22: 2 curated edge(s) in HYP04_Linkage_Map_v1.0.csv (sha256 e7b0881186751f32...), loading clean with 0 of 2 rows rejected. Read through curated_linkage.load_curated_linkage() when this version was generated, not asserted by the author. A count is recorded here because a registry version is a point-in-time record; live code must read the count from disk instead.
required_external_measurement.availability_is_not_sufficiency: 'exists_partial' does NOT mean the required measurement is satisfied, and it moves nothing toward display. The display gate's threshold counts eligible ANCHOR EVENTS; curating linkage edges does not change that count. Phase 1 remains blocked.
required_external_measurement.placeholder_description_correction: v1.0 through v1.2 described this as 'same-sector peers (GST_Task2_PeerDivergence.py limitation)'. That wording described GST_Task2_PeerDivergence.py, which IS genuinely sector-based, and was inherited here in error. The package corrected it in __init__.py on 2026-08-18 and in its README on 2026-08-22; this is the registry catching up. The error ran in the dangerous direction -- it OVERSTATED the placeholder's quality, in a field whose purpose is to warn. Earlier registry versions are not edited; they remain on disk with the original wording.

forbidden_substitutions: sector membership as a stand-in for a supply-chain relationship
return or volatility correlation as a stand-in for an established business relationship
any linkage map lacking a first-known/established-as-of date, applied to historical events
hypotheses.forbidden_substitution_rule: If the linkage for an anchor-peer pair is unavailable or undated, that pair simply does not count toward HYP-04. Sector proximity is never silently substituted for a supply-chain relationship, and a missing linkage is never inferred from price behaviour.

unresolved_analysis_decisions.decision: two-way clustering (anchor event x calendar period) -- Phase 0 ships one-way (anchor event) clustering only, because no multiway CR2/Satterthwaite implementation exists in this repository, validated or otherwise

whether implied volatility is ever promoted from a secondary/robustness target to a primary one -- unresolved because the Phase 0 coverage audit measured CURRENT option chains only and no historical options source has been obtained

the reported lag quantity's uncertainty treatment -- onset_horizon is late-biased by construction under an expanding-window target, and is reported with that caveat rather than as an exact point estimate

options_tension_note.statement: Stage 2 of the HYP-04 model constructs options-adjacent hedge recommendations (protective put, put spread, collar, sector-ETF proxy). Phase 0 sizes nothing and executes nothing: it emits recommendation objects against an ASSUMED long-equity holding, with no real position, no order construction, and no capital logic of any kind.
options_tension_note.formal_options_eligibility: OUT OF SCOPE FOR THIS ENTRY. This registry version does NOT register HYP-04, or any hypothesis, against options_implied_move or joint_attention_plus_options. Those classes continue to carry DENY_NO_REGISTERED_HYPOTHESIS, unchanged.
options_tension_note.deferred_to: Phase 4, at which point Stage 2 would need options eligibility to mean something operationally. Resolving it then requires its own dated registry decision, exactly as options_related_classes.rule already specifies.
options_tension_note.why_recorded_now: So the tension is visible at registration rather than discovered at Phase 4. Registering an exploratory equity-volatility hypothesis whose downstream stage is options-shaped is a deliberate, bounded decision, not an oversight.

hypotheses.display_rule: No result, direction, effect estimate, plot, p-value or confidence interval may be displayed before 193 eligible events. The hypothesis accrues no eligible events at all while its status is PREREGISTERED_MEASUREMENT_NOT_IMPLEMENTED. No result computed on the Phase 0 placeholder (same-sector) linkage may be displayed as a HYP-04 result under any circumstances, at any event count.

peer_return_ingestion.note: Provider-free by design; closes are operator-supplied.

event_to_peer_join.note: Derives uses_placeholder_linkage; a caller cannot assert it.

capture_path_modules.module_existence_is_not_data: A module that CAN ingest is not ingested data. Both flags report only that a MODULE imports; both data_captured flags are false, and no observation has been captured through either path. This distinction is the reason HYP-04's status is unchanged.

hypotheses_carried_forward_unchanged.note: HYP-01, HYP-02 and HYP-03 are defined in v1.0 and are NOT restated here. v1.0 remains the authoritative, unedited source for all three. Restating them would create two mutable copies of the same governed text and invite exactly the drift this project's tamper tests exist to catch.

options_related_classes.rule: The data-eligibility classes continue to exist and events may continue to be classified into them. No named hypothesis is registered against either class, so no result derived from them may be displayed. Registering one is a separate, dated decision.
options_related_classes.options_never_block_the_registered_hypot: An unavailable options benchmark may lower an event to 'core_only_no_option_benchmark'. It never prevents HYP-01, HYP-02, HYP-03 or HYP-04 enrollment when that event's own required core fields are otherwise valid.
options_related_classes.hyp04_explicitly_not_registered_here: HYP-04 is registered against core_attention_vs_equity_response on its anchor side and against NO options class. Its Stage 2 being options-shaped does not register it against an options class, and this version does not lift DENY_NO_REGISTERED_HYPOTHESIS.

counting_rules_note: The ten counting rules CNT-1 through CNT-10 in v1.0 apply unchanged to HYP-04. They are not restated here for the same reason the three carried-forward hypotheses are not.

statistical_governance.promotion_rule: HYP-02, HYP-03 and HYP-04 may never be promoted to confirmatory on the basis of observed results. Promotion requires a new dated registry version written before the results that would motivate it are seen.
statistical_governance.model_freeze_rule: No model may be changed after the eligible event set is frozen.
statistical_governance.unresolved_terms_rule: Any exact model term or outcome mapping not already established in an existing authoritative specification is marked PENDING_SEPARATE_ANALYSIS_LOCK and is never guessed.
statistical_governance.power_statement: No power calculation was performed using observed project results, and none may be. The numeric thresholds are GOVERNANCE ELIGIBILITY FLOORS -- the minimum evidence required before a result may be looked at -- not claims of guaranteed statistical power, and not estimates of detectable effect size. This characterisation applies to HYP-04's 193 exactly as it applies to HYP-01/02/03's 60/60/40. HYP-04's floor was informed by a design calculation on SYNTHETIC fixtures with a hypothetical, pre-chosen effect size and no project data; that provenance is recorded in full under its minimum_eligible_events_basis so the number can be audited rather than taken on trust, and it does not convert the floor into a power claim.
statistical_governance.multiplicity_note: Four hypotheses are now registered. HYP-01 alone is confirmatory; HYP-02 is secondary; HYP-03 and HYP-04 are exploratory, and neither carries any confirmatory claim. Any multiplicity adjustment ACROSS these families remains PENDING_SEPARATE_ANALYSIS_LOCK and is not resolved by this version. HYP-04 carries its own WITHIN-hypothesis multiplicity treatment (max-T permutation across its horizon grid); that is internal to HYP-04's own analysis and is not a cross-family adjustment.
statistical_governance.adding_a_hypothesis_rule: A new hypothesis enters this registry only via a new dated registry version, authored before any observation or result for that hypothesis exists. v1.1 added HYP-04 under that rule: AT THAT TIME zero HYP-04 eligible events existed, no linkage map existed, and no HYP-04 result had been produced or looked at. That is a statement about the conditions when HYP-04 was added, not about the present -- curation began 2026-08-22. The eligible-event count and the result are still zero and null respectively.

eligible_event_counts.note: Zero for every hypothesis, including HYP-04. No candidate has been screened for HYP-04, no prospective HYP-04 event has been observed, and no result exists. A curated linkage map now exists in part (availability 'exists_partial') and is nowhere near sufficient; it is NOT a reason these counters are non-zero, because they count eligible ANCHOR EVENTS, which curating linkage edges does not produce. These counters are structural placeholders.

results_note: Deliberately null. No result, direction, effect estimate, plot, p-value or confidence interval exists for any hypothesis, and none may be produced before that hypothesis's threshold is reached and its event set and analysis commit are frozen. HYP-04's Phase 0 feasibility work produced diagnostics on synthetic fixtures and a placeholder linkage; none of it is a result about this hypothesis and none of it may be reported as one.

external_measurement_availability_vocabu.does_not_exist: No curated data of this kind exists anywhere in the repository.
external_measurement_availability_vocabu.exists_partial: Real curated data exists and validates, but is nowhere near sufficient for the hypothesis. This state NEVER means the measurement is satisfied, and it is not a step toward display: the display gate's event-count threshold counts eligible ANCHOR EVENTS, which curating linkage edges does not move.
external_measurement_availability_vocabu.exists: Curated data exists and is sufficient for the registered measurement. NOT YET USED BY ANY HYPOTHESIS.

external_measurement_availability_vocabu: Introduced by v1.3. 'exists_partial' is added because two curated edges are not a linkage map: recording them as 'exists' would weaken that word everywhere else it appears. Defined here rather than left for a reader to infer from usage.

contradiction_corrected.why_it_happened: v1.3 corrected required_external_measurement.availability and inherited two other statements of the same fact. Its guards verified that immovable fields had not moved and that no other hypothesis changed; nothing verified that the field being corrected had no surviving copies elsewhere in the document.
contradiction_corrected.guard_added: make_registry_v1_4.find_availability_contradictions() walks the whole document and reports every non-exempt string asserting the map does not exist while availability says otherwise. build_v1_4 runs it on its OWN output and refuses to write a failing document, so this class cannot ship again.
contradiction_corrected.no_effect_on_results: Nothing computed from either sentence and no display-gate condition read them. No result, decision or gate state changed.
